_comment: Clause 'This enters the arena with 2 steam counters': ON_ENTER_PLAY fires from Zone.add for items (state.py:309); PUT_COUNTER defaults its target to the source card, which is what we want. Clause 'At the start of your turn, destroy this unless you remove a steam counter': START_OF_TURN reaches only the turn player's cards (trigger_types.py note), matching 'your turn'. The CONDITIONAL/COUNTER_GTE guard exists because CHOOSE offers both options unconditionally - without it, a counterless Clamp Press could pick 'remove' as a no-op and survive for free. DEVIATION from the triage list: it named CONTROLS_SUBTYPE for the pump, but that condition (a) scans only player.permanents, which does not include the items zone, and (b) gates on OWNING a wrench rather than tying the bonus to the attacking wrench - it would have pumped every attack once any wrench was in play. Used ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN ['Wrench'] + ATTACK_CONTROLLED_BY_YOU against the current attack instead: engine._dsl_recalc_listener dispatches RECALC_ATTACK_POWER to p.items, so this WHILE_STATIC re-evaluates on every power recalculation and its MODIFY_ATTACK lands in the stage-8 window (no accumulation). ATTACK_SUBTYPE_IN reads 'subtypes' and checks combat.attack_card types+subtypes; 'Wrench' is a real DB subtype on wrench weapons and Wrench-subtype attacks, all of which are 'wrenches you control' when on your side. Crank itself is a printed keyword (DB keywords field) - not authored.
